elements.before: Independent, lender-grade analysis for automobile dealerships across floor-plan, blue-sky and acquisition, SBA 504, conventional real-estate, net-lease, and subprime-finance capital. This page is our standing read on why the floor-plan lien defines every dealership credit, how blue-sky and fixed-operations absorption forecasts fail review, and the difference between the market study, the feasibility study, and the appraisal a dealership file requires.
elements.after: What carries a dealership once new-car gross normalizes? In 2024 average gross profit per new vehicle fell to $2,247,2 so Feasibility Study Company builds its auto dealership feasibility studies around fixed operations, F&I and used vehicles. We prepare them, market study included, for dealer owners, buyers and developers and for the floor-plan, SBA 504, conventional real-estate and net-lease lenders who finance the store. Each one sets out the blue-sky evidence, the floor-plan lien and service absorption in terms a credit committee can check.
